serviceDefinitions.name: API Gateway
serviceDefinitions.description: Public ingress; routes and authenticates external traffic.

serviceDefinitions.name: Order Service
serviceDefinitions.description: Order placement and lifecycle; publishes order events.

serviceDefinitions.name: Notification Service
serviceDefinitions.description: Turns order events into customer notifications.

serviceDefinitions.name: Email Dispatcher
serviceDefinitions.description: Consumes the email queue and calls the email delivery provider.

serviceDefinitions.name: Legacy Report Cron
serviceDefinitions.description: Nightly order export for finance. Owner unassigned.

serviceDefinitions.name: Fraud Scoring
serviceDefinitions.description: Real-time risk scoring for payment attempts.

serviceDefinitions.name: Ledger Service
serviceDefinitions.description: Double-entry ledger fed by payment events.

metadata.note: p95 latency elevated; waiting on inventory-db replica

eventTypes.name: OrderPlaced
eventTypes.description: Emitted when a customer order is accepted and awaiting payment.

eventTypes.name: OrderCancelled
eventTypes.description: Emitted when an order is cancelled before fulfilment.

eventTypes.name: OrderShipped
eventTypes.description: Emitted when an order leaves the warehouse.

eventTypes.name: StockLevelChanged
eventTypes.description: Emitted when available stock for an item changes.

eventTypes.name: StockReserved
eventTypes.description: Emitted when stock is held against an open order.

eventTypes.name: PaymentCaptured
eventTypes.description: Emitted when funds are captured for an order.

eventTypes.name: PaymentFailed
eventTypes.description: Emitted when a capture attempt is declined or errors. No consumer is modeled yet.

eventTypes.name: RefundIssued
eventTypes.description: Emitted when a refund is sent back to the customer.

eventTypes.name: NotificationRequested
eventTypes.description: Published when a customer message is ready for delivery; routed to the email queue.

businessFlows.name: Checkout
businessFlows.description: From a placed order to a shipped, paid order and a customer notification.

businessFlows.name: Refund
businessFlows.description: A customer refund from request to ledger posting.
